name: vs-tab-release
about: Variable Studio 1's tab right-click › Release… (the Free plan's upgrade); Esc

excluded.why: Live's take is the Free plan's upgrade modal (Release… on an account without release management), which Esc closes. With managed workflows on, the Create Release candidate dialog ignores Esc and only Close closes it (live docs-versions-release-1118), as ours.
